revert-object-auth.description: v2 canReadRecord returns true again: any tenant can read any record by id.

revert-function-auth.description: v2 authorizeAdmin trusts the client-supplied body role instead of the verified token role.

revert-token-check.description: v2 verifyToken only decodes the token (decodeJwt), skipping signature, audience and expiry.

revert-webhook-verify.description: v2 verifyWebhook returns true: the webhook is acted on with no signature or replay check.

revert-path-confine.description: v2 resolveFilePath drops the normalization/confinement guard, so ../ escapes again.

revert-field-allowlist.description: v2 vetUpdate returns the whole body, so a protected field can be mass-assigned.

revert-prompt-separation.description: v2 buildPrompt folds the untrusted record body back into the instruction channel.

revert-headers.description: v2 guardStateChange allows every state change with no headers, CSRF or same-origin check.
